purpose: Rhythm-game tap chart; onset-informed subdivisions, not polyphonic transcription
strengthOfBeat1: Accent deliberately placed on perceived beat 2 for gameplay, while synced timestamps and local timing corrections remain unchanged.
note: Additional notes based on spectral-onset detection; review in gameplay; precise triplets are heuristic. time values measured from the start of the original MP3.
syncMethod: Compare detected beats to 120-BPM baseline every 4 bars (8 sec); robust median correction, smoothed and interpolated; all offbeat/fill events anchored to locally corrected beat times.
timingReference: Seconds from MP3 beginning; use HTMLAudioElement.currentTime, not wall-clock timers.

silenceFilter.approach: Preserve prior locally corrected timestamps and note classifications. Omit beats before confident full accompaniment at ~4.4 s, during sustained very-low-energy periods, and during terminal fade after ~229.1 s. Quiet passages are retained where the backing beat continues.

accentAdjustment: Accent moved one additional beat earlier than the beat3 version; now on beatInBar=3 (perceived beat 2). Synced timestamps unchanged.
